query: escape of water, weeping joint, discovered June reported August, late notification

results.title: Escape of water notified 51 days after discovery
results.summary: Tenant identified damp in March, notified in May. Denied under the 30-day notification exclusion. Upheld on review: the exclusion turns on the date of discovery, not the date the full extent became apparent.

results.title: Slow leak, damage worsened between discovery and notification
results.summary: Same pattern. Denied. The insured's argument that the damage looked minor at discovery was not accepted as a reason to extend the window.
